about: A family-owned Mexican kitchen that has fed Chicagoland since the 1970s, Taco Patio prides itself on fresh food, generous portions and friendly service. It runs two stores, Lockport and Bellwood, and also caters taco and fajita bars for parties and fundraisers.
tagline: Family-made tacos and big burritos, open late on Butterfield.
hours: Bellwood: Sunday–Thursday 10 AM–12 AM; Friday & Saturday 10 AM–2 AM (tacopatio.com site footer, 'Bellwood Hours', and /locations/)
notes: Address/phone match trail data (4018 Butterfield Rd, 708-544-1112; site adds 'between Frederick Ave and Mannheim Rd'). Hours match trail data. Founding year is inconsistent on the site: body text says 'since 1976', page title says 'Since 1979'. The menu posted on the site is labeled Lockport (Aug 2025); Bellwood menu may differ. The site's Facebook link is the Lockport page. Main 'Order Online' button goes to the Lockport SpotOn store; Bellwood ordering is the Heartland link. Several site images (1.png–9.png series, e.g. tamales, torta, cheese-pull enchiladas) look like stock and were not used; the taco and combo-plate photos used appear to be the restaurant's own but provenance is not stated. Catering photos are likely the Lockport store.
